premise: At 59, after 29 years as a mail carrier, I used $136,000 of my pension to co-found a locksmith and home-security business with my brother-in-law, who notarized a 50% share and free rekeying for my senior neighbors, but after a regional security company offered $610,000 for the accounts and equipment he forged a dissolution, sold the assets, and mailed me a $4,200 'tumbler' check; I retrieved our signed agreement from inside the hollow base of a key-cutting machine, voided the sale, and now run 'Key of Deceit Locksmith,' where he greases lock cylinders in a vest that says 'Picked My Pension' and every work order prints his fraud-docket number.
